title: Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 G glider prototype on grass, March 1945
description: Photograph of the A.W. 52 G tailless glider prototype parked on a grass airfield, viewed from behind its large wingtip fin, with roundel markings on the wing and a hangar in the background. Inscription at lower right reads "A.W. 52 G (PROTOTYPE) MARCH 1945 A-32714 A.C.". Part of a report section on British tailless aircraft.
